metadata.title: Network Remote Access

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability enabling secure remote connectivity for users, administrators, and services operating outside institutional network boundaries.

props.name: technology-platform
props.remarks: Remote access gateways, identity-aware access brokers, and secure remote connectivity platforms.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Identity- and context-aware remote network access with no implicit trust based on client location.

props.name: data-entity
props.remarks: Remote access session metadata, authentication context, posture signals, and access logs.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Remote access is evaluated using identity, device posture, and context rather than relying on network perimeter trust.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Remote access is enforced using identity-aware, policy-driven networking consistent with Zero Trust Networking concepts.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Remote access capabilities align with SP 800-46 telework and remote access guidance, modernized through Zero Trust Architecture.

metadata.remarks: Network Remote Access defines how users, administrators, and services connect to institutional network resources from external locations. This pattern eliminates implicit trust based on network location and ensures remote access is mediated through identity- and context-aware enforcement. It does not define authorization policy, segmentation rules, or egress controls, which are handled by complementary Secure Network patterns.

components.title: Remote Session Establishment
components.description: Establishment of authenticated and controlled network sessions from external locations.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Use of valid accounts to establish unauthorized remote access.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Identity-aware access brokers restrict remote session establishment.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Authorize and manage remote access sessions based on identity and access policy.

components.title: Remote Context and Posture Assessment
components.description: Evaluation of remote device posture, authentication strength, and environmental signals.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Exploitation of trusted but compromised remote endpoints.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Assessment of device security state prior to granting remote access.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Authenticate remote users and validate contextual indicators.

components.title: Remote Access Enforcement
components.description: Ongoing enforcement and reassessment of remote access privileges during active sessions.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Persistence through unauthorized modification of remote access permissions.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Continuous enforcement and revalidation restrict unauthorized remote activity.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Enforce approved access states and revoke remote access upon policy violation.
